_comment: A full cube with a distinct top, which is the face that says what the block is -- a trough you look down into. No facing property: a trough has no front, and a block with nothing to aim would only give a player a rotation to get wrong. Sides and bottom share their construction with the Station's casing; tools/generate_block_textures.py draws all of them and holds their frames to one another. The element is written out rather than inherited from block/cube_bottom_top so that every face states its own cullface and so that tools/render_block_model.py can draw it -- a model whose geometry lives in a vanilla parent is a model nothing in this repo can look at.

elements.__comment: Every face spans the block boundary, so every face culls.
